name: Mihara Takaya
source:
A man who took over from his father at a young age and now owns several love hotels.
Since he was working in the sex industry, he had always been a womanizer, After meeting Kosozu, he discovers the joy of treating a woman as a slave, and he is plotting to get hold of Rion, who he has had his eye on for some time.
He frequently uses hotels to make contact with his prey, when contacting his prey, he hides his true identity and pretends to be a reporter.

He was once reluctant to follow in his father's footsteps, and out of resentment, he got a job as an employee at the hotel where Rion currently works. however, in the end, the service industry didn't suit me.

After his father passed away suddenly, he returned home and settled into his current position. in the end, he was devastated that he had no choice but to live in the sex industry,

After meeting Kosozu, he was able to get over it, and now he is making full use of his power as a love hotel owner to get his hands on prey.
